committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 23 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: landingPageTest.creditRemainingExGst is at $0 and ads.campaignStatus shows PAUSED, with spendLast7 down to $0 from $82.41 prior7 and clicksLast7 at 0 versus 12 prior7. Lifetime spend ex GST is $1977.43 across 108 raw paid clicks since the test started 6 Oct, and review_cta_click still reads 0 for the whole test, so the pause lines up with the rule since no qualified booking is on record.

adsChanges shows no external edits in the last 24 hours or 7 days, so this week's zero spend and zero clicks reflect the credit running out rather than any outside account change. rankLost30d (74.2) still outweighs budgetLost30d (16.2), though the budget stays fixed while the test concludes.

Across the whole test, ask_cta_click sits at 17 against review_cta_click at 0: the short question form keeps getting the clicks but nobody has taken the deeper booking step yet, even with 108 raw paid clicks logged.

generate_lead has reached 3 raw events since the test started, but leads.last7 is 0 (prior7 was 1): none of this is confirmed demand yet, and Chris still needs to grade each one against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) before counting it.

actions.text: totalPaidClicks has reached 108, past the 75-click threshold: check the test log now, if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries the red flag fires.
creditRemainingExGst is now $0: apply the pause rule, continue paid search only if cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
generate_lead sits at 3 raw events since the test started: check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source and grade each against the qualified rule in the test log.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success: update to match current site stats.
